uncertain_points.claim: The assertion AesSecCmKeyMaskingStateShare allows bypass of the state share diversity check when SecAllowForcingMasks && force_masks_i is true.
uncertain_points.risk: An attacker with control of force_masks_i could freeze mask values, revealing secret key shares through side-channel leakage.

uncertain_points.claim: The assertion AesSecCmKeyMaskingStateShare also bypasses the check when dec_key_gen_o == SP2V_HIGH, relaxing state share diversity during key expansion.
uncertain_points.risk: Inadequate masking during key expansion could leak expanded round key material.

uncertain_points.claim: The assertion allows the state share check to pass even when state_q is constant for one round if a difference existed between past(state_q, NumCyclesPerRound) and past(state_q, 2*NumCyclesPerRound). It is unclear whether this is sufficient for masking security.
uncertain_points.cond: state_q unchanged over the last round but changed one round earlier.
uncertain_points.risk: Potential insufficient entropy refresh, weakening side-channel resistance.

uncertain_points.claim: The assertion AesSecCmKeyMaskingOutputShare uses $past(state_o[s]) on the cycle after out_valid_o rises. If state_o is updated in the same cycle as out_valid_o, the captured value may be the old output share, not the intended new one.
uncertain_points.cond: rising edge of out_valid_o when crypt_o high.
uncertain_points.risk: The assertion may verify freshness against an incorrect share value, leading to false positives or undetected failures.
